method: Each case was read manually: the test name and example HTML in tests.json define the intended barrier, and every fail finding (any check) was compared to it; yes means a fail reason names the right element and problem, partly means the right element with the problem missed or only implied, no means no fail finding describes it.

Plain language is not used.note: understandable-text flags the dense legislative text with no plain-language summary.

Content identified by location.note: use-of-colour fail says the winner is identified only by 'on the right'.

Idioms and jargon are not explained.note: understandable-text names the unexplained idioms and jargon.

First instance of abbreviation not expan.note: Flags GDS used first without expansion or title.

Content is not organised into well-defin.note: headings-structure says the long multi-topic passage has no subheadings or structure.

Meaning depends on pronunciation that is.note: Identifies the heteronyms 'record' and 'close' with no pronunciation given.

Colour alone is used to convey content.note: Says text colour alone marks safe versus deadly mushrooms.

Focus not visible.note: Flags the Search button showing no visible focus change.
